title: A Mixtape for the Semester
author: Edmund Joubert
blurb: Juniper Okonkwo, the only out kid in a town of nine hundred, has spent three years being so careful it hurts. But when the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
